Keep all drawn material close to the crest. A very fine incandescent WHITE core nested within translucent ice-cyan soap film and a delicate #BFE8FF bloom. Narrow cooler cyan refractive lip on one side so it reads over white bubbles as well as over pastel blue. The interior underneath is empty transparency: NOT a filled cap or barrier. The line occupies only a very thin band. High-end cute, clean and rounded casual game effects art, subtly reflective and magical, legible at small size. Real continuous RGBA transparency, semi-transparent halo tapers into alpha zero.
Strict negatives: gold, yellow, saturated beads, large white flashes or starbursts, round jewel balls, big bubbles, cloud humps, scallops, curly waves, surf, splashes, realistic foam, thick opaque milk, smoke, snow, waterfalls, rampant particles, galaxies. No floor, background, checkerboard, cast shadow, panel, words, labels, frame, phase numbers, montage, UI. One sprite only.

selection_note: P3 第二次生成增加了离开主弧的泡沫和水珠。

export.geometry: 沿生成原图的亮芯做纵向配准，按预乘 alpha 采样。原图的分叉光丝、泡沫与残光保留。近芯和远离光线的泡沫使用不同的纵向缩放，以保留上浮间距。
export.color: 以冷白高光和青蓝折光为主，对齐冷色通道；P2、P3 的浅蓝底预览用于调整亮芯和折光边的对比。
export.parameter_units: x/y 为原图左端、中点、右端的配准参考点；edges、c 分别为交付图端点 x 和中心亮芯 y。所有阶段的端点基线为 y=150。v、up 为纵向采样倍率。
export.below_baseline: 第151行起仅保留极低 alpha 并向下衰减。
